decision_rule.score_rule: The context-controls label requires at least three passed tests; this event passes one.
decision_rule.summary: Compute a four-test gate for whether rain context and change-map availability can control the Barren Island ash-plume classification.

report.description: Remote Barren Island Volcano emits a small plume of ash on September 25, 2010.

provenance.notes: All scored values are recomputed from local CSX-306 dates, precipitation summaries, and change-scene counts.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the requested numeric fields, final classification, and one short computed consequence.
criteria.name: Answer form
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the values are recoverable but field names or nesting differ.

criteria.description: Computes the report image date, locked event start, and date offset correctly: 2010-09-25 minus 2010-09-03 equals 22 days.
criteria.name: Timing term
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for finding the two dates but making a small arithmetic or direction error.

criteria.description: Computes point_precip_mean_mm = 13.645, regional_peak_precip_mm = 184.585, and peak_to_point_ratio = 13.528 within tolerance.
criteria.name: Rain aggregation
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1 point for each correct precipitation component and 1 point for the ratio.

criteria.description: Computes change_scene_total = 0 from the four radar and optical pre/post counts.
criteria.name: Change-scene count
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for finding the zero-count products but summing only one sensor.

criteria.description: Applies the four threshold tests correctly and reports rain_change_gate_score = 1.
criteria.name: Gate score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correctly evaluated threshold test.

criteria.description: Returns source_proximal_ash_anchor_controls and rejects rain_or_change_context_controls from the score being below 3.
criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct rejection with incomplete wording.
